subject.why: Accurately depicts the 1950s retro TV with rabbit ears, legs, knobs, and glowing screen.

category.why: Renders the TV on a stylized tabletop against a simple gradient wall.

clean.why: Contains no UI, text, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with ample margins around the TV and antennae.

colour.why: Warm, vibrant palette with clear separation between the object and background.

detail.why: Features clean, broad surfaces without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Matches the chunky, soft-shaded 3D look of the reference cards.
